venues.name: Welch Hall
venues.imageAlt: Welch Hall on the University of Texas at Austin main campus
venues.description: Welch Hall contains some of the largest lecture halls and classrooms on main campus and will be the main venue for COMPEL 2027.

venues.name: Engineering Education and Research Center (EER)
venues.imageAlt: The Engineering Education and Research Center building at UT Austin
venues.description:
Home to UT Austin's Chandra Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, the Engineering Education and Research Center (EER) spans over 450,000 square feet of learning and research space. It houses Texas Inventionworks' 23,000-square-foot makerspace, the Texas Materials Institute's advanced materials analysis and nanofabrication facilities, and the Texas Innovation Center for emerging ventures and startups.

Attendees can sign up for the tour of EER's facilities on Friday 6/17 as part of their registration at no additional cost.

venues.name: J. J. Pickle Research Campus
venues.imageAlt: Aerial view of the J. J. Pickle Research Campus in northwest Austin
venues.description:
The Pickle Research campus is UT Austin's 475 acre research facility located in northwest Austin (9 mi from main campus). Among its facilities include the Microelectronics Research Center (MER), which facilitates research in electronic, spintronic, and MEMS materials, devices and systems with its 12,000 ft of class 100 cleanroom space. The Center for Electromechanics (CEM) supports research in electric machines, grid solutions, and hydrogen energy systems.

Attendees can sign up for the tour of Pickle campus on Monday 6/14 as part of their registration at no additional cost. Transportation to Pickle from main campus will be provided.
